# Contract: every sample line below carries the inline allow marker, so this committed
# fixture never fails `python scripts/scan_secrets.py` on the repository. The tests strip
# the marker to prove the same lines are still detected when the exemption is removed.
# None of these values authenticate to anything.

password = notarealpassword12345  # secret-scan: allow -- fabricated sample
authorization = Bearer abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789  # secret-scan: allow -- fabricated sample

# False-positive control. The lines below deliberately carry NO marker: they are the policy
# vocabulary this repository uses to *refer* to credentials and must never be flagged.
credential_ref: secret-ref://claude/agent-auth
secrets_policy: REFERENCE_ONLY
secret_storage: os_credential_manager
